objectives: Choose the right type of certification for a client's document.
Carry out a signature certification, including for documents about real estate.
Prepare a simultaneous certification of signature and content in the right number of copies.
Certify a copy and state in the endorsement what the law requires.
Calculate the fee for common certifications.

cards.front: Name the five certifications a notary performs on private documents and copies.
cards.back: Date, signature, content, signature and content at the same time, copy (Art. 589–591 ГПК).

cards.front: What must a person do for a signature certification?
cards.back: **Appear personally** and sign before the notary or confirm an existing signature (Art. 589(2) ГПК).

cards.front: What is added when the document is for rights in real estate?
cards.back: The person **writes the full name** by hand before the notary (Art. 589(2) ГПК); fee 10 лв. per signature.

cards.front: How many copies for a simultaneous certification of signature and content?
cards.back: **Two or more** identical copies; one is filed in a special book (Art. 590(4) ГПК).

cards.front: Name three documents that need signature and content at the same time.
cards.back: Power of attorney for a notarial-deed deal; transfer of company shares; transfer of an enterprise; marriage contract (Art. 37 ЗЗД, 129 and 15 ТЗ, 39 СК).

cards.front: What three things does a copy endorsement state?
cards.back: Who presented the document; whether copied from the original or another copy; any deletions, additions, corrections or peculiarities (Art. 591(1) ГПК).

cards.front: What does a date certification achieve?
cards.back: A **certain date** towards third persons (Art. 589(1) ГПК).

cards.front: Where are date and signature certifications recorded?
cards.back: In a special register: the **general register** (Art. 590(2) ГПК; Art. 7 Наредба № 32).

cards.front: What happens to the private document after certification?
cards.back: It is **returned** to the person who presented it (Art. 590(3) ГПК).

cards.front: Fee for the first signature without material interest?
cards.back: 5 лв. = **2.56 €**; each next signature 2 лв. (item 5 ТНТ).

cards.front: Fee for certifying a one-page copy?
What happens if the person did not appear personally for a signature certification?

quiz.question: A client brings a power of attorney to sell her flat, already signed at home. What does the notary do?
options: Certifies signature and content at the same time; the client writes her full name and confirms the signature before the notary
Refuses because it was signed at home
quiz.explanation: A power of attorney for a deal in notarial form needs signature and content certified at the same time; for real estate the full name is written before the notary.

quiz.question: How many copies of a share transfer contract does the office need?
options: Two or more identical copies, one stays in the archive
Only a copy for the archive

quiz.question: A husband wants to certify his wife's signature because she is at home ill. What is the answer?
options: No; she must appear personally, or the notary may visit her for a good reason
Yes, if he brings her ID card
Yes, if she signed in advance
quiz.explanation: Personal appearance is required; acts other than deeds for entry can be done outside the office for good reasons.

quiz.question: What must a copy endorsement state?
options: Who presented the document, whether it is copied from the original or a copy, and any corrections or peculiarities
Nothing beyond the signature and seal

quiz.question: A lease contract will be used against a future buyer. Which certification gives it a certain date?
quiz.explanation: Date certification gives a certain date towards third persons.

quiz.question: A client asks to certify a signature on a blank sheet "to fill in later". What do you do?
options: Refuse; the notary certifies only complete documents
Certify it if the client is known
quiz.explanation: The notary must check the content for legality; a blank sheet has no content to check and invites abuse.

quiz.question: What is the fee for certifying two signatures on a declaration without material interest (no real estate)?
options: 7 лв. (3.58 €): 5 for the first and 2 for the second
quiz.explanation: Item 5: 5 лв. for the first signature and 2 лв. for each next one.

quiz.question: What is the fee per signature on a declaration that will be used for a real estate deal?
options: 5 лв. for the first and 2 for the next

quiz.question: After certifying a power of attorney for actions before a bank, what must the office also do?
options: Enter an extract in the information system of the Notary Chamber at once
Send it to the Registry Agency

quiz.question: Which certified copy has the same evidential force as the original?
options: An officially certified copy of an official document
Any copy certified by a notary
A copy of a private contract

quiz.question: A client presents an English contract that will not be entered. The notary does not read English. What is the correct approach?
options: Use an interpreter or a translation so the notary understands the content
Ask the client to summarise it
quiz.explanation: Art. 589(3) applies Art. 582 accordingly; the notary must be able to check legality.

quiz.question: A power of attorney had its signature certified in Varna on Monday and its content in Sofia on Friday. Does it meet Art. 37 ЗЗД for a sale of real estate?
options: No, signature and content must be certified at the same time
quiz.explanation: Art. 37 requires certification of signature and content performed at the same time.
